mapper.select: /* SQL ID : SmnrAtndHstryDAO.userSmnrAtndHstryList 설 명 : 사용자세미나참석이력목록 */ SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY HSTRY.REG_DTTM DESC) AS LINE_NO , HSTRY.ATND_SDTTM , HSTRY.ATND_EDTTM , HSTRY.ATND_SCNDS , HSTRY.ATNDE_IP , HSTRY.CNTN_DVC_TYCD , HSTRY.ATND_STSCD , (SELECT CDNM FROM TB_LMS_CMMN_CD WHERE UP_CD = 'CNTN_DVC_TYCD' AND CD = HSTRY.CNTN_DVC_TYCD) AS CNTN_DVC_TYNM FROM TB_LMS_SMNR_ATND_HSTRY HSTRY JOIN TB_LMS_SMNR SMNR ON SMNR.SMNR_ID = HSTRY.SMNR_ID AND SMNR.DELYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_ATNDLC ATNDLC ON HSTRY.ATNDE_ID = ATNDLC.USER_ID AND ATNDLC.SBJCT_ID = SMNR.SBJCT_ID AND ATNDLC.AUDITYN = 'N' JOIN TB_LMS_USER USR ON ATNDLC.USER_ID = USR.USER_ID AND USR.USER_STSCD = 'ACTV' WHERE SMNR.SMNR_ID = #{smnrId} AND HSTRY.ATNDE_ID = #{atndeId}
